svg.title: Separation of concerns
svg.desc: Creators upload big videos to a streaming site built two ways. In one web app that also encodes, the uploads tie up the workers so viewers get slow pages, and an encoder crash takes the whole site down. Split by concern, uploads go on a queue to encoder workers, a crash just puts the job back on the queue, and viewers keep streaming from the CDN.
svg.text: When encoding crashes, only the split design keeps viewers watching.
